top_signals.title: Gold Climbs as Pause in Mideast Fighting Curbs Inflation Risk
top_signals.summary: Gold rose, after a pause in fighting between the US and Iran over the weekend eased oil supply risks and inflationary concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Oil slides 5% as Iran reportedly signals halt to attacks if U.S. pause holds
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell after Iran reportedly said it would suspend attacks as long as a U.S. pause in hostilities remains in place.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s Rare Earth Strategy Is Forcing a U.S. Manufacturing Revolution
top_signals.summary: Beijing is now desperately attempting to bring rare earth manufacturing back inside its own borders, exclusively. New Chinese export restrictions specifically target American plans to begin the country’s first commercial production of rare earth magnet materials by 2027. To counter that move, REalloys (NASDAQ: ALOY) is rebuilding every major stage of North America’s rare earth industry. Over the past two years, the company has assembled heavy rare earth feedstock, separation, metallization, alloy production, and permanent magnet manufacturing…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
